title: fusion.implementer-result/v1
description: DRAFT, plan step 12: the code-implementer's domain result, the profile's result_schema and the object the host places in the role input as output_contract. It is the three-field report the role's neutral text mandates (agents/code-implementer.md, Report shape): the files changed, one verification entry per check run in exactly one of three forms, and a result the verification decides. done requires at least one verification entry and every entry of the exit form with exit code 0; any other entry makes the result blocked, and the implement step of workflows/repair.v1.json stops as escalated on blocked. The result is a claim: host.capture.v1 captures the change and runs the checks itself, and a change outside the write scope refuses the attempt whatever this object says. Prior's embedded contract at 167c605 (modules/fusion/roles/roles.go, outcome and summary) is replaced by this one on the ruling that fusion authors the output contract (67.7). No $schema keyword: the host compiles every bundle schema as draft 2020-12 and this file must carry no URL.

files_changed.description: Every file the implementer modified, as absolute paths under workspace.root of the role input, which is what the neutral text mandates; empty when it changed nothing. The host relates them to write_paths by stripping the root, and host.capture.v1 decides from the tree, not from this list.

verification.description: One entry per check the implementer ran. exit: it ran and read the code. did-not-finish: it started and never returned a code. none: nothing was run, and detail says why. At least one entry, never left out.

command.description: The exact command, on exit and did-not-finish; absent on none.

detail.description: What stopped it (did-not-finish) or why nothing ran (none).

result.description: done or blocked; the verification entries decide which.
